title: First-Class Appendices for Print Reports and Zwischenbericht Anhänge
description: Add first-class appendix support to the semio print system (print/tex/): an appendix is a document attached to the main report, behaving like a chapter — numbered A, B, C…, labeled Anhang/Appendix, TOC entry, chip styling, cross-referenceable via \appendixref, listed via \listofappendices. Fix a pre-existing bug where window registers (\listoffigures etc.) render header-only because semio@render@register reads the wrong body macro. Wire the feature into all six print templates (report, paper, flyer n/a, zukunftbau forschungsbericht/zwischenbericht/kompaktbericht). Then apply it to mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex: convert 9 Anhang markdown documents from temp/ into 8 LaTeX appendices (A-H), including a 67-project table with per-row avatar images sourced from temp/projekt_bilder/ (downscaled ~600px, copied into zwischenbericht/asset/projekt/). Update body cross-references to use \appendixref. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/print-reports-should-be-joyful-haven.md.
summary:
Removed the last duplicate key: after restructuring User Stories into 4 appendixsections, each story's title still repeated its ID as literal text ("US-BB-02 — Baukomponenten zu...") right next to the chip that already renders it (US-BB.2) — the chip is now the canonical key, so the embedded copy was pure duplication.

Stripped the "US-XX-NN — " prefix from all 35 `\subsection{...}` titles in anhang/user-stories.tex, leaving clean descriptive titles. To avoid losing the traceability the embedded ID provided — the Anforderungsmapping table's "Zugeordnete User Stories" column cross-references stories by exactly this ID — added a `\label{us:xx-nn}` right after each story heading (e.g. `\label{us:bb-02}`) and rewrote every mention in the Anforderungsmapping table from hardcoded text ("US-BB-01, US-BB-05") to `\ref{}` calls (`\ref{us:bb-01}, \ref{us:bb-05}`). This resolves to the live chip number automatically, so the cross-reference can never drift out of sync with the actual heading again, unlike the literal text it replaced.

Verified: rebuilt clean (zero errors, zero unresolved refs), confirmed via the built PDF that story titles are now ID-free ("Baukomponentendaten erfassen" with chip US-BB.1 as the sole key) and the Anforderungsmapping table now shows the matching auto-derived chip text (e.g. REQ-01 → "US-BB.1, US-BB.5"). Checked all 35 labels against all 35 \ref calls: perfect 1:1 bijection, no orphans on either side.
